title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Training Note: Changing the Service Level of a Booking
content:
The service level of a Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery booking can be changed while the booking is in scheduled status, the last status in which the service level can be upgraded, provided the new level serves the items. The base fee of the old level is credited, and the new level's charges are billed under the Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery booking rules, including any free-threshold and Finch Circle credit due at the new level.

## Questions this rule answers

**In which status can the service level be changed?**
In scheduled status. Once the booking has gone out for delivery, the status is past the last status in which the level can be upgraded.

**Which new levels are open?**
A level that serves the items on the booking.

**What happens to the old level's fee?**
The base fee of the old level is credited.

**What is billed for the new level?**
The new level's charges, under the booking rules, as for a booking at that level.

**Are savings recalculated?**
Any free-threshold credit and any Finch Circle credit due at the new level are given at the new level.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures, not those of any service level)

A scheduled booking moves from a level with a base fee of $60.00 to a level with a base fee of $150.00 that serves all its items; the booking has items and stairs within both levels' allowances. The old level's $60.00 base fee is credited; the new level's $150.00 base fee is billed under the booking rules, and any free-threshold and Finch Circle credit due at the new level is given on the new charges.
